spec.text: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt at a cost factor of 12.
spec.why: src/passwords.mjs uses scrypt (N=16384, r=8, p=1). There is no bcrypt anywhere.

spec.text: The minimum password length is 12 characters.
The maximum password length is 128 characters.
Passwords on the common-password list are refused.
A password may not contain the local part of the user's email address.
An account locks after five consecutive failed login attempts.
A lock lasts 15 minutes.
The response to an unknown email is identical to the response to a wrong password.
A user whose email address is not verified cannot log in.
Access tokens are signed with HMAC-SHA256.
Access tokens expire 15 minutes after they are issued.
spec.why: ACCESS_TTL_SECONDS = 3600 since commit "Longer access tokens for the mobile client". It was 900 at v2.2.0.

spec.text: Tokens declaring any algorithm other than HS256 are refused.
Up to 30 seconds of clock skew is tolerated.
Refresh tokens are single use, and reusing one revokes its whole token family.
spec.why: used flag and family revocation in refresh.mjs.

spec.text: Refresh tokens expire after 30 days.
A session ends after 30 minutes without activity.
A session ends 12 hours after login, whatever the activity.
A user may hold at most five concurrent sessions. Starting a sixth ends the oldest.
spec.why: Not implemented. sessions.mjs has no limit.

spec.text: Each client IP may make 100 requests a minute. Further requests are refused with a retry time.
Reset links expire after one hour and work once.
Completing a reset ends every active session for the account.
Every failed login is recorded with the client IP address.
Passwords are never written to the audit log.
Verification links expire after 24 hours.

checklist.text: All automated tests pass on main.
Every automated case in the test plan has a passing automated test.
checklist.why: 61 of 84 automated cases have a test. Four of those 61 do not test what they are named for.

checklist.text: CHANGELOG lists every behaviour change since 2.2.0.
checklist.why: The access token lifetime went from 15 to 60 minutes (git diff v2.2.0 v2.3.0 -- src/tokens.mjs). The changelog does not mention it.

checklist.text: package.json version matches the release tag.
No TODO or FIXME comments left in src/.
checklist.why: src/ratelimit.mjs carries a FIXME added after 2.2.0.

checklist.text: README documents every environment variable the service reads.
checklist.why: TURNSTILE_SECRET and TURNSTILE_ISSUER, both in the README.

checklist.text: Licence file present and matches package.json.
SECURITY.md names a contact for vulnerability reports.
The authentication spec has been reviewed against the implementation.
checklist.why: Four of the spec claims are false at 2.3.0: 2.1, 2.2, 4.2 and 5.3.
